decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of "The Girl on the Train," which is ambiguous because there are three distinct films with the same title across different years: 2009, 2013, and 2016. Each film has its own director, as stated in the original sources: Larry Brand (2013), Tate Taylor (2016), and André Téchiné (2009). These are separate referents and do not conflict. The candidate 'Quentin Tarantino' is not supported by any original source and conflicts with the explicitly stated directors.
